questions.stem: Which of the following correctly completes this sentence? Tennis is played either on a grass surface ___ on a clay surface.
Which word correctly completes the sentence? Bella was running late but did she ___ the bus? (dropdown)
Click on the highlighted word that is a proper noun in this sentence. Doctors and nurses met Joy and her Grandmother at the Hospital door.
Which of the following correctly completes this sentence? When Dave ___ the hot plate to Mum he was careful.
Which of the following correctly completes this sentence? Their family celebrated a win ___ Thursday.
Which two words in this sentence are adjectives? Neither Dan nor Mark enjoyed the loud music being played in the busy mall.
Which word correctly completes the sentence? Orienteering, a running sport, ___ in Europe in 1918. (dropdown)

Complete the sentence correctly. Draw lines to match each word with the part of the sentence that should follow it. People go ___ Sweden ___ a five-day orienteering event that is held ___ the Swedish government.
Which word correctly completes the sentence? A bike race in Australia, ___ attracts thousands of spectators, happens every two years.
Which word correctly completes the sentence? To 'orient' ___ means to work out where you are. (dropdown)
Tick the box to show if the sentence is a question or a statement. (columns: question / statement)

questions.stem: Which sentence has the correct punctuation?
options: This is not your bag exclaimed Mark
“This is not your bag,” exclaimed Mark!”
this is not your bag! exclaimed Mark.
“This is not your bag!” exclaimed Mark.
questions.selected_answer: “This is not your bag!” exclaimed Mark.
